Done. Summary:

- `out/T2/solution.py`: plain torch/safetensors script that slices head 5 out of `c_attn.weight` (per q/k/v segment, column blocks), `c_attn.bias` (same layout), and `c_proj.weight` (row blocks) for all 12 layers, leaves every other tensor untouched, and asserts the required shapes (`[768,2112]`, `[2112]`, `[704,768]`) and the 160-tensor count before writing — so it fails loudly if any check doesn't hold.
- `out/T2/run.sh`: runs the script from the sandbox root.
- Ran it once; output `out/T2/model.safetensors` has 160 tensors with the correct shapes (verified independently by reloading and checking `h.0.attn.c_attn.weight` → `[768, 2112]`, bias → `[2112]`, `c_proj.weight` → `[704, 768]`, plus untouched tensors like `attn.bias` mask still `[1,1,1024,1024]`).
- `out/T2/REPORT.md` written per the template.

I used only `torch`/`safetensors` from the allowed list (plain scripting) rather than `transformers.prune_heads`, since the task gave exact column/row ranges to keep and a direct script made the concatenation order and checks fully explicit and auditable.
